name: Glorious Heat (Mythic)
body:
Your fire spells are a nearly inexhaustible font of healing.

Prerequisite(s): Glorious Heat.

Benefit: You double the healing and attack roll bonus provided by this spell. By expending one use of mythic power, you extend the duration of the attack bonus to 1 round per mythic tier you possess.
